review_scope: Read-only comparison of bytes key with original strict typed tuple domain, inherited handle/cache behavior and 74-case XML. No tests or native rerun by reviewer.
observations: Every encoded value is exact built-in primitive; float finite/type guards preserve signed-zero/int-vs-float distinctions. Pickle protocol5 is dumps-only; custom reducers/subclasses cannot enter the payload.

Owner, ordered nodes/occupancy presence, services, ordered edge values, capacity values and fault tuples are included. Equal bytes decode uniquely within this closed primitive domain; alias-sensitive pickle output can at worst reduce hits, never conflate different encoded values.
Only newly built primitive tuples are serialized; no observation, job, ACK, source truth or mutable object is retained by bytes keys. Unsupported shapes still fall back to unchanged original routing.
Serial factory/key replacement is restored in finally; overlap and unexpected key mutation are rejected. Existing live-handle lifetime caveat and read-only observation contract remain unchanged.
